Leadsforge

Leadsforge provides lead search, company discovery, and contact enrichment APIs for sales prospecting workflows.

32 actionsAPI key

Connect Leadsforge

  • Count LeadsCount people matching Leadsforge person and company filters without returning lead records.
  • Find Mobile PhoneFind one person's mobile phone number synchronously using a Leadsforge person ID, LinkedIn URL, or name plus a company signal.
  • Find Work EmailFind one person's work email synchronously from a Leadsforge person ID, LinkedIn URL, or full name plus a company signal.

  • Get Maps CategoriesReturn Leadsforge's curated Google Maps business categories recommended for Start Maps Business Search.
